content_sections.heading: NIT Delhi Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
NIT Delhi Assistant Professor Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Delhi Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Assistant Professor position at NIT Delhi is scheduled for 31st August 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech. and MCA/M.E./M.Tech. or an equivalent qualification in the relevant area/discipline, along with a Ph.D. in the relevant area.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Assistant Professor post at NIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Assistant Professor position ranges from Rs. 49,650 to Rs. 80,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at National Institute of Technology Delhi, Delhi - 110036.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation provided?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits or age relaxation details for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification followed by a Walk-in Interview.
